ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future fraud scheme: A deeper dive
ideas.description: Investigate the details of the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme and its connections to Minnesota
questions: What was the impact on Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the details of the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme, including the key players, how the scheme operated, and the impact on Minnesota. It would also explore the international cooperation that led to the arrest of Abdikerm Eidleh in Somalia.
